curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When the cross-country investigation uncovers clues pointing beyond a single killer, who else is involved in the abductions?
curatedMovie.description: Forensic psychologist Alex Cross joins forces with escaped captive Kate McTiernan to track down a predatory serial killer whose kidnapping trail spans from North Carolina to Los Angeles.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful crime thriller with a measured pace that rewards focused attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This tense crime mystery delivers a steady, grounded manhunt where forensic profiling meets firsthand survival against a calculating predator.
